provenance.note: Controlled synthetic stimulus with known ground truth: not real market data and not market profitability evidence.
provenance.recovery_estimator: recovery = w_bar @ alpha where w_bar is the mean active-row weight vector and alpha is the planted/null alpha from universe.json
provenance.regime_model: Volatility regime detection via classify_volatility_regimes_percentile with vol_hysteresis from hysteresis_band_grid; regime_filter applies a single causal scalar scale factor per date (minimum across assets) via regime_scale_scalar, preserving dollar-neutrality exactly. Calm regime uses beta_window=120, quantiles=0.25; stress regime uses beta_window=60, quantiles=0.35.
